name: 3d-web-experience
title: 3D Web Experience
description: Three.js/WebGL scenes, shaders, procedural geometry, camera systems, lighting, depth, particles and environmental effects - only when they improve the project.
when_to_use: The request or brand genuinely benefits from spatial storytelling (product visualisation, architecture, immersive brand moments). Not for decoration.
instructions: Decide first: state why 3D helps this audience; recommend no_3d when it does not.
Lazy-load the scene, pause when off-screen (IntersectionObserver/visibilitychange), cap DPR, target 60fps on mid-range mobile.
Respect prefers-reduced-motion and provide a static fallback image/poster; keep JS for the scene under ~150KB.
Keep content and CTAs readable over or beside the scene; 3D never blocks the primary action.
